Sobre o cargo: ​

O HEAL (Health Ecosystem Account Leader) será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento e a execução das estratégias de Market Access no mercado privado, alinhadas às prioridades estratégicas da Biogen, atuando como o principal representante da companhia junto ao ecossistema da saúde suplementar.

O profissional será responsável pela gestão estratégica das principais contas nacionais e regionais, incluindo Operadoras de Saúde, Sistemas Verticais, Redes Hospitalares, Centros de Infusão, Clínicas Especializadas, Administradoras de Benefícios, Grupos Econômicos e demais stakeholders relevantes da saúde suplementar.

Atuará como líder estratégico das contas sob sua responsabilidade, desenvolvendo relacionamentos sustentáveis e de longo prazo com executivos das áreas médica, auditoria, gestão clínica, oncologia, neurologia, doenças raras, farmacoeconomia, suprimentos, acesso, negociação, inovação e alta gestão das organizações de saúde.

O HEAL será responsável por compreender profundamente o modelo assistencial, os fluxos de decisão, os modelos de remuneração, os indicadores de qualidade, os protocolos internos e as prioridades estratégicas de cada conta, desenvolvendo Planos Estratégicos de Contas (Strategic Account Plans) que promovam acesso sustentável às terapias Biogen e fortaleçam a parceria institucional.

Como líder do ecossistema privado, atuará identificando oportunidades para transformar a jornada do paciente, remover barreiras de acesso, apoiar modelos inovadores de cuidado, desenvolver projetos colaborativos de gestão em saúde e gerar valor compartilhado para pacientes, operadoras, prestadores e para o sistema de saúde.

O profissional trabalhará de forma integrada com as áreas de Medical Affairs, Marketing, Comercial, Value & Access, HEOR, Government Affairs, Supply Chain, Regulatório, Finanças e Compliance, liderando estratégias multifuncionais para as contas estratégicas.

Também será responsável por acompanhar continuamente o ambiente competitivo, tendências regulatórias da saúde suplementar, movimentações da ANS, modelos de remuneração baseados em valor, protocolos clínicos, incorporação de tecnologias e indicadores assistenciais, transformando inteligência de mercado em oportunidades estratégicas para a Biogen.

O que você vai fazer:

•

Desenvolver e implementar Planos Estratégicos de Contas (Strategic Account Plans) para Operadoras de Saúde, Sistemas Verticais, Redes Hospitalares e demais contas estratégicas.

•

Construir relacionamento institucional com executivos das áreas médica, acesso, auditoria, farmacoeconomia, suprimentos, inovação e alta liderança das contas sob sua responsabilidade.

•

Mapear continuamente estruturas organizacionais, fluxos decisórios, influenciadores, protocolos assistenciais e modelos de financiamento das contas.

•

Desenvolver estratégias customizadas para ampliar o acesso sustentável às terapias Biogen considerando as necessidades específicas de cada organização.

•

Identificar e eliminar barreiras de acesso durante toda a jornada do paciente na saúde suplementar.

•

Liderar discussões sobre protocolos clínicos, diretrizes institucionais, incorporação tecnológica e modelos de cuidado baseados em valor.

•

Desenvolver projetos colaborativos com operadoras e prestadores voltados para melhoria dos desfechos clínicos, eficiência assistencial e sustentabilidade do sistema.

•

Apoiar iniciativas de geração de evidências, farmacoeconomia, Real World Evidence (RWE) e Value Demonstration.

•

Promover programas de educação científica e gestão em saúde junto aos stakeholders das contas estratégicas.

•

Desenvolver relacionamento contínuo com sociedades médicas, líderes de opinião, centros de excelência e instituições privadas de referência.

•

Monitorar indicadores assistenciais, utilização das terapias, cobertura, autorizações e oportunidades de melhoria da jornada do paciente.

•

Acompanhar continuamente o ambiente regulatório da ANS, atualizações do Rol de Procedimentos, tendências da saúde suplementar e modelos inovadores de remuneração.

•

Compartilhar inteligência de mercado e apoiar a construção das estratégias da afiliada.

•

Liderar o planejamento integrado das contas em parceria com Medical Affairs, Marketing, Comercial, HEOR, Supply Chain, Finanças, Regulatório e Compliance.

•

Desenvolver iniciativas voltadas à expansão do acesso, fortalecimento das parcerias institucionais e geração de valor compartilhado para clientes e pacientes.

•

Garantir que todas as atividades sejam conduzidas em conformidade com as políticas da Biogen, Código de Conduta e princípios éticos e de Compliance.

Requisitos:

•

Formação superior completa em qualquer área. Pós-graduação será considerado um diferencial.

•

Sede em São Paulo.

•

Inglês avançado.

•

Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais.

•

Conhecimento aprofundado do Sistema de Saúde Suplementar brasileiro.

•

Conhecimento da dinâmica das Operadoras de Saúde, Sistemas Verticais, Redes Hospitalares e Prestadores Privados.

•

Conhecimento dos processos de cobertura, reembolso, autorização e incorporação de tecnologias no mercado privado.

•

Conhecimento da legislação da ANS, Rol de Procedimentos e modelos assistenciais da saúde suplementar.

•

Conhecimento em Avaliação de Tecnologias em Saúde (ATS/HTA), Economia da Saúde e Medicina Baseada em Evidências.

•

Conhecimento dos modelos de remuneração em saúde (Fee-for-Service, Bundled Payment, Capitation e Value-Based Healthcare).

•

Experiência em Gestão Estratégica de Contas (Strategic Account Management).

•

Capacidade de compreender o ecossistema privado e desenvolver soluções colaborativas para melhoria da jornada do paciente.

•

Excelente capacidade de relacionamento com executivos C-Level e tomadores de decisão.

•

Habilidade de negociação, influência e construção de consenso.

•

Liderança em ambientes matriciais e gestão por influência.

•

Forte visão estratégica e orientação para geração de valor.

•

Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados clínicos, econômicos e assistenciais.

•

Alta capacidade de planejamento, organização e priorização.

•

Perfil empreendedor, colaborativo e orientado para resultados.

About the Team

DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality.

About the Role

In this role, you’ll manage a 8-15k sq ft distribution center, the local warehouse operating team, and be responsible for ensuring we maintain high quality for our customers.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead

• Serve as site leader for a high-volume DashMart site, leading a team of at least one leader Assistant Site Manager), Shift Leads (3+), and Operations Associates (20+).
Set clear expectations, operating rhythms, and performance standards for leaders at all levels, ensuring accountability for safety, quality, productivity, and engagement.
• Develop leaders, not just teams — coaching, performance managing, and building succession plans to ensure a strong leadership bench.
• Own site culture and engagement outcomes, making intentional decisions to protect standards and address underperformance in service of both people and results.
• Partner with leaders to delegate execution while maintaining visibility into outcomes, risks, and opportunities across the building.

Own

• Own end-to-end operational performance of a single DashMart site, with full accountability for safety, compliance, labor, quality, and cost.
• Serve as the final site accountable owner for operational compliance, including adherence to DashMart SOPs, safety standards, food handling requirements (where applicable), and regulatory obligations.
• Lead site readiness for audits, inspections, and reviews; proactively identify risks and drive corrective actions through leaders.
• Own workforce planning, scheduling strategy, and labor budgets, making data-driven decisions to balance efficiency, service levels, and team well-being.
• Ensure site-level KPIs are met or exceeded, and take decisive action when performance trends indicate risk.

Delight Customers

• Ensure a consistently excellent customer experience by establishing and enforcing operational standards that deliver high order accuracy, speed, and reliability.
• Hold leaders accountable for customer-impacting metrics, using data to diagnose root causes and drive sustainable improvements.
• Partner cross-functionally with central teams (inventory, training, quality, safety) to align site execution with enterprise standards and initiatives.
• Represent the voice of the site by surfacing insights, risks, and opportunities that inform broader operational improvements.

Strategize

• Own the site-level operating strategy, aligning people, processes, and resources to current volume demands and future growth.
Use data and judgment to anticipate constraints related to labor, space, throughput, and leadership capacity, and proactively design solutions.
Lead complex, cross-functional improvement initiatives that address systemic issues rather than one-off fixes.
• Translate regional and central strategies into clear site priorities, ensuring leaders understand the “why” behind decisions and execute with discipline.
• Make informed tradeoffs between speed, cost, quality, and engagement to deliver sustainable performance at scale.

We’re excited about you because…

You’re a culture champion and people-first leader who knows how to build strong teams while delivering results in fast-paced environments.

• You bring 3+ years of team leadership experience in high-volume operations (retail, grocery, hospitality, fulfillment, logistics, or similar), with a proven track record of developing talent and driving performance.
• You’re a proven people leader, having successfully led high-performing teams of 25+ employees, and you take pride in coaching, growing, and preparing future leaders.
• You act like an owner. You’re energized by the responsibility of supporting a 24/7 operation across multiple shifts and are excited to take ownership in a rapidly growing business.
• You thrive in ambiguity. Rapid change, learning on the fly, and building structure in evolving environments excite you.
• You’re data-driven and analytical. You let data guide decisions and have experience using Excel or Google Sheets to analyze performance, including basic formulas and pivot tables.
• You have a college degree or equivalent professional experience.
• You have flexibility in your schedule. As the site leader, you ensure the team and operation are fully supported, including some late-night and weekend availability.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). Overview

Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.

With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

Job Purpose

This is a front-office analytical generalist role within the OTC Trading business, spanning trade and product support, platform support, new product implementation, business management, capital analysis and process improvement. The role is designed to give the successful candidate broad exposure to the operating model of an institutional OTC derivatives business, with the expectation that they will progressively take ownership of one or more functional areas over time.

Candidate Profile

This role is suited to a high-calibre analytical generalist with strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to become effective quickly in unfamiliar subject matter. The ideal candidate may not yet be a specialist in OTC derivatives, but will be able to absorb complexity, ask good questions, structure problems clearly and build credibility with Trading, Quant, Risk, Treasury, Operations, Technology and Compliance colleagues. Over time, the successful candidate will be expected to develop deeper ownership of one or more functional areas.

Responsibilities

Across all areas, the role requires strong analytical judgement, intellectual curiosity, the ability to learn unfamiliar products and systems quickly, and the confidence to operate in an evolving front-office environment where responsibilities may not always be neatly defined.

Business Management

• Support capital management activities, including funding, FX exposure, liquidity management, intercompany capital flows and related analysis, working closely with Treasury teams.
• Build and maintain reporting that helps management understand trading activity, revenues, return on capital, capital utilisation and business performance.
• Analyse data, identify trends, explain drivers and help convert business information into actionable management insight.
• Prepare materials for management meetings, governance forums and strategic business reviews.

Platform Support

• Support client and broker onboarding onto trading platforms, including configuration, access and product setup.
• Act as business-facing support for client and broker platform queries, distinguishing straightforward user issues from matters requiring Technology or Quant involvement.
• Track recurring platform issues, identify root causes where possible, and help improve support processes, documentation and user experience.
• Assist with user testing, rollout and adoption of new platform functionality.

Trade & Product Support

• Develop a practical understanding of OTC product structures, trading workflows and lifecycle events across FX, Energy and Agricultural products.
• Support traders with product setup, trade booking, workflow queries and operational issues, working closely with US-based Trade & Product Support colleagues.
• Help identify recurring issues, control gaps or workflow inefficiencies, and support improvements to coverage, process and escalation.

New Product Process

• Support the administration and continuous improvement of the New Product Approval Process.
• Coordinate implementation of approved products between Trading, Risk, Operations, Technology, Treasury and Compliance.
• Track implementation progress, outstanding actions, dependencies and readiness for release.
• Maintain process documentation and contribute to clear, scalable governance practices as the product set expands.

Continuous Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve processes and reduce manual effort, including through use of AI technology.
• Author and maintain business process and workflow documentation.
• Support implementation of new tools and business initiatives.

Qualifications

Knowledge and Experience

Essential Profile

• Strong academic and/or professional track record in an analytically demanding environment.
• Ability to work with data, identify patterns, explain drivers and produce clear analysis for decision-making.
• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex issues concisely.
• Strong judgement, ownership and follow-through, including the ability to manage ambiguity and escalate appropriately.
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving front-office environment with changing priorities.

Relevant Experience

• Approximately 4-8 years’ professional experience in financial markets, consulting, business analysis, product control, operations, technology, data analysis or another analytically demanding environment.
• Prior exposure to OTC derivatives, trading workflows, Treasury, Risk, Operations, platform support or business management would be helpful but is not required.
• Strong Excel capability is expected; SQL, Power BI, Python or similar tools would be advantageous.
• Exposure to Murex or other trading platforms would be beneficial but is not a prerequisite.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or another analytically rigorous discipline.

To land this role you will need:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
• Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Strong interpersonal skills, with confidence working with senior stakeholders and specialist teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication.
• Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, evolving front-office environment.
• Curious mindset with a willingness to learn new products, systems and business areas.
• High attention to detail while maintaining awareness of the wider business context.
• Ability to identify process improvements and drive change.
• Team-oriented and collaborative, with a proactive mindset and a willingness to take ownership and drive issues through to resolution.

About the team

The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.

This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows.

Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with top startups to identify where Codex can have the greatest impact on how their teams build and ship software.

- Design and lead technical talks, live demos, workshops, hackathons, and repeatable hands-on programmes that turn initial interest into sustained adoption.

- Work directly with selected customers to build Codex workflows, integrations, and automations, resolve technical blockers, and evaluate effectiveness and reliability.

- Turn successful approaches into reusable code examples, guides, and tools that help more startups succeed with Codex and OpenAI’s broader platform.

- Collaborate with account teams, developer experience, and ecosystem partners to reach developers and founders, prioritise opportunities, and drive measurable customer value.

- Translate customer experiences and developer feedback into actionable insights for OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

- Have experience building at, founding, or working closely with early-stage startups, and understand the pace, ambiguity, and practical trade-offs involved.

- Bring strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy building practical AI applications, integrations, and developer tools.

- Are an active user of Codex or other AI coding tools, with a thoughtful perspective on how they can improve software development.

- Are a compelling communicator who enjoys presenting, delivering live demos, and leading hands-on workshops for developers and founders.

- Have a talent for turning complex technical ideas into clear explanations, engaging examples, and reusable resources that help others succeed.

- Combine developer empathy with sound technical judgment: you can uncover what a team needs, troubleshoot problems, and help them adopt effective, reliable workflows.

- Bring high agency, curiosity, and end-to-end ownership, working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues and ecosystem partners.

jobs.description: AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Data center Logistics Specialist positions. The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to Safety & Operational Excellence. Logistics Specialists monitor inventory levels to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained to support build and repair activities. They receive parts, maintain inventory, and check-out parts as needed to Data center Technicians and Engineers. They will also be responsible for loading and unloading shipments and transporting parts between different locations. This position involves frequent lifting of materials and products. Logistics Specialists will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company. They must also maintain the cleanliness, organization, and safety of all work spaces. They must be available to work weekend shift work. The ideal candidate will have experience working in a warehouse or distribution environment, as well as experience and knowledge of reverse logistics processes. Experience handling vendor relationships is helpful. NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered. NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States). Key job responsibilities Physical and Environmental Demands All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodation • Requires standing, sitting, and walking for prolonged periods of time. • Typically work is in a warehouse or data center environment where the noise level is moderate to loud. • Occasionally assist in loading and unloading shipments. • Occasionally exposed to extreme cold or hot weather Work Environment • You are a role model for safety behavior and culture • Thrive and contribute to a work culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion • Work with and/or around moving mechanical parts • Noise level varies and can be loud • Temperature between 60 and 90 degrees, and will occasionally exceed 90 degrees Key job responsibilities • Ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing • Assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials • Assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations • Keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company • Understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker). A day in the life The Logistics Specialist reviews Data Center inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in the all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with the Logistics Manager, you will create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. You will work closely with Data Center Operations Technicians and Data Center Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. You will also work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. Regular and ongoing communications with vendors to resolve issues and help them understand our business requirements necessitates a high-level communicator. In addition, Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker). All candidates should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organization skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful. You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided. About the team AWS is committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. You will be trained on data center safety, policies, procedures, and guidelines. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the Team

DoorDash for Business is building the premier corporate dining and benefits platform—helping companies of all sizes feed their teams through industry-leading products and meal programs. Our mission is to become the go-to solution for executives, administrators, and employees who need seamless, high-quality food programs at work. We move fast, operate with an ownership mindset, and are growing new product lines to better serve our corporate customers.

About the Role

As a Strategy & Operations Senior Associate for DoorDash for Business, you'll be at the center of piloting and scaling product features that transform delivery quality, making sure every order arrives on time, accurate, properly labeled, and backed by strong options when something goes wrong. You'll shape the experience for clients, dashers, and merchants across the entire journey, not just one piece of it. This is a build-and-launch role: you'll partner cross-functionally to design testing frameworks and go-to-market plans, then turn insights from our core audiences into real product improvements. Expect to wear a lot of hats, from support and analytics to close partnership with product, often all in the same week.

You will report into the Manager, Strategy & Operations for DoorDash for Business and can work remotely or hybrid depending preference.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Experiment – Use data-driven decision-making and sound business judgment to run tests and lead product/ feature improvement efforts
• Optimize – Partner with product and engineering teams to continually sharpen the tools that drive quality
• Analyze – Build models that evaluate economics and patterns, turning data into clear decisions
• Execute - Design and run test plans and initiatives that measurably improve merchant and dasher quality
• Collaborate – Work across sales, partner management, operations, product, engineering, and business development to elevate the experience for merchants, dashers, and clients alike

We're excited about you because…

• You have 3+ years of experience in strategy and operations, commercial management, operations, or consulting; direct management experience, high-growth startup (scaling a business from 0 - 1) experience is preferred
• You have a proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, hitting goals, and succeeding in a complex and fast moving environment
• You are an excellent analytical thinker who can deliver actionable recommendations out of complex datasets; intermediate SQL experience strongly preferred
• You are customer obsessed - whether that is our clients, merchants or dashers and comfort talking / working with people from all walks of life
• You’re unafraid of ambiguity. You don’t need a playbook. You dive into difficult problems and come up with a plan. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. - Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.

AWS Professional Services partners with customers worldwide to accelerate their cloud journeys, from migration and modernization to building entirely new capabilities. Our engagement managers are the connective thread between technical delivery and business strategy, ensuring every project creates lasting value.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence.
